title: VM Retractable Clamp Phone Holder
body_html:
This phone holder puts your phone front and centre on the handlebar of your electric scooter or e-bike. It fits phones from 5.4 to 7.2 inches, and it turns a full 360 degrees, so you can run navigation in portrait or landscape.

The side arms close around your phone, and a separate locking switch holds them shut until you release it. Soft silicone on the arms protects the edges of your phone, the cradle leaves the camera clear, and the base is aluminum alloy.

Mount it on the bar with the included clamp, or on a mirror mount with the offset adapter. Set your route before you ride and keep your eyes on the road.

Features

  • Fits phones 5.4 to 7.2 inches
  • 360-degree rotation for portrait or landscape
  • Separate locking switch for the arms
  • Silicone-padded arms
  • Leaves the camera clear
  • Aluminum alloy base
  • Handlebar clamp and mirror-mount adapter included

Specifications
Phone size: 5.4 to 7.2 in
Rotation: 360 degrees
Color: Black

title: VM Large-View Side Mirrors
body_html:
VM Large-View Side Mirrors give you a wide look at the road behind you on both sides of your electric scooter or e-bike. The large angular heads hold blue-tinted glass, and the matte black housings carry a sharp geometric pattern on the back.

They mount at the ends of your handlebar instead of above it, keeping the bar clear for lights, a phone holder or your display. Each arm slides into the open end of the bar and locks in with an expanding sleeve, and the kit includes two sleeve sizes for different bar openings. Angle each mirror to suit your riding position, then glance at traffic without turning your head.

Your handlebar needs an open end to take the sleeve, so check yours before you order.

What's in the box

  • 2 mirror heads with blue-tinted glass
  • 2 mirror arms
  • 4 bar-end sleeves in two sizes
  • Mounting bolts and cone nuts
  • Hex key

Specifications
Mount: Bar end
Glass: Blue-tinted
Color: Matte black
Sold as a pair

title: VM USB Rechargeable Front Light
body_html:
The VM USB Rechargeable Front Light puts a bright four-lens beam on the road ahead of your electric scooter or e-bike. The body is aluminium with a finned lower edge, and it sits on a quick-release handlebar mount, so the light slides off and comes with you when you park.

When the battery runs low, charge it over USB from a wall adapter, power bank or laptop, with no batteries to buy or swap. One button on top cycles through multiple brightness and flashing modes, with an indicator light right beside it.

Use the steady modes to light up dark streets and bike lanes, and the flashing modes to help drivers notice you in daytime traffic.

Features

  • Four-lens front
  • USB rechargeable, no batteries to buy
  • Multiple brightness and flashing modes
  • One-button control with indicator light
  • Aluminium body
  • Quick-release handlebar mount

Specifications
Charging: USB
Body: Aluminium
Color: Black
Mount: Quick-release handlebar mount

title: Anti-theft Ignition Key Lock for EMOVE Cruiser V2 / Cruiser V2 AWD / RoadRunner Pro V2 - Direct from Factory
body_html:
SPECIFICATIONS

High-concerned chemical: None

Origin: Mainland China

Protect your high-performance seated electric scooter with a dedicated keyed power lock.

The EMOVE Cruiser V2 / Cruiser V2 AWD / RoadRunner Pro V2 is a powerful electric scooter platform, so controlling access to its power system is important. This accessory introduces a physical key requirement into the scooter’s electrical activation process. With this key, the scooter cannot be turned on normally unless the matching key is inserted and rotated to the operating position.


Installation is designed to be straightforward. The lock assembly uses a compatible electrical connector that plugs into the scooter’s original wiring system, reducing the need for wire cutting, soldering, or controller programming.


After installation, simply insert the key and turn it to enable the scooter’s power system. When parking, turn the key back to the off position and remove it. Anyone without the matching key will be unable to activate the scooter through the normal power-on procedure.


This accessory is especially useful for riders who share storage areas, park at workplaces, keep their scooter in a garage, or want to prevent children or unauthorized individuals from switching on the scooter.


Helps Prevent Unauthorized Power-On

Without the matching key, the scooter cannot be started through its normal power system.


Better Access Control

Useful when multiple people can physically access the scooter but only authorized riders should be able to turn it on.


Convenient Daily Operation

The key switch is mounted within easy reach of the rider and does not require a phone or separate electronic remote.


Reversible Accessory Installation

Because the system uses a compatible plug connection, it may be removed or replaced more easily than a permanently hardwired modification.


Suitable for Storage and Parking

Useful for scooters stored in apartment parking areas, garages, warehouses, workshops, offices, or shared spaces.

How It Works

To turn the scooter on:

  1. Switch the scooter off.

  2. Turn the ignition key to the OFF position.

  3. Remove the key.

  4. Use an external physical lock when leaving the scooter unattended.

To secure the scooter:

  1. Insert the matching key into the ignition lock.

  2. Turn the key to the ON position.

  3. Activate the scooter using its normal controls.

  4. Confirm that the display and electrical system power on correctly.

title: Teverun 67.2V 6A Fast Charger for Blade GT II and Blade Mini Ultra
body_html:
The charger in the box with your Teverun pushes 2 amps, so a flat pack takes about 15 hours. This one pushes 6 amps. Same voltage, same connector, three times the current.

Put the scooter on charge when you get home and it is ready the same evening, instead of the next morning.

Those times are approximate. A battery slows down as it nears full, so the last few percent always take longer than the arithmetic suggests, and temperature and pack age move it too.

What it fits

  • Teverun Blade GT II, 60V 30Ah
  • Teverun Blade Mini Ultra, 60V 27Ah

What it does not fit

This is a 60V charger, so it is not the right charger for a 72V or 52V Teverun. It does not fit the Fighter Supreme 7260R, the Fighter Supreme Ultra, or the Space Lite. If your scooter is not one of the two listed above, message us before you order and we will tell you which charger you need.

Specifications

  • Output: 67.2V DC, 6.0A, 403.2W
  • Input: 100 to 240V AC, 50/60Hz, 8.0A max
  • Connector: 3 pin GX16, the same plug as your stock charger
  • Model: XVE420-06720600
  • Certification: CE, FCC, RoHS, Energy Efficiency Level VI
  • Housing: finned aluminium, IP20, indoor use only

Reading the light

  • Blue: plugged in and working
  • Red: charging
  • Green: full, or not connected to the scooter

Charging safely

Charge indoors on a hard surface, not on carpet or a bed, and not shut inside a cupboard. This unit moves 403 watts and the aluminium case is finned because it is meant to get warm. Give it air. Try not to leave a charge running unattended overnight, which is a good deal easier now that it finishes in an evening.

title: Display for Inmotion Climber
body_html:
The replacement display and power button assembly for the Inmotion Climber. This is the unit that sits on the stem: it carries the power button, shows your speed and battery level, and passes the control signals down to the controller.

What is in the box

  • Display housing with the integrated power button
  • Attached wiring loom, terminated in the waterproof round connector the Climber uses

Before you order

This is the Climber-specific part. Inmotion displays are not interchangeable across models: the RS and the Climber use different assemblies and different looms, so a display from another model will not simply plug in.

Check your connector before ordering. Unplug the existing display at the stem and compare it to the photos. If yours does not match, message us with a photo before you buy and we will tell you which part you need. That one check saves a return.

Fitting it

It is a plug and play swap rather than a soldering job. Unplug the old loom, feed the new one through the stem, seat the connector until it clicks, and refit the housing. Take your time seating the connector fully: a partly seated waterproof plug is the most common cause of a display that flickers or will not power on after a swap.

Genuine Inmotion part, stocked in our US warehouse, with US-based support seven days a week.

title: 48V 3A Charger for VM 1
body_html:
The genuine 48V 3A charger for the Aptum VM 1. This is the same unit the scooter ships with, so there is no guesswork about voltage, current or fit.

UL2272 certified

The VM 1 electrical system is UL2272 certified, and that certification covers charging as well as the battery and controller. It matters more than most spec lines: UL2272 is the standard written specifically for personal electric mobility devices, and it tests the whole system rather than a single component.

It is also why a cheap third-party charger is a bad trade. An off-brand unit at the wrong voltage or with no proper cutoff can overheat a pack, shorten its life, and will usually void your warranty. On a battery worth many times the price of this charger, that is not a saving.

Made for the VM 1, not adapted to it

48V output at 3A, matched to the VM 1 pack. It talks to the battery management system the way the scooter expects, charges at the rate the cells are rated for, and stops when the pack is full instead of trickling heat into it.

What you get

  • 48V 3A output, matched to the Aptum VM 1
  • Charge status indicator, so you can see at a glance when it is done
  • Standard AC power lead plus the output cable
  • Ventilated housing that runs cool through a full charge
  • Automatic cutoff when the pack reaches full

Why keep a second one

Most riders who own two end up leaving one at work or at a parent's house. A charger you never have to remember to pack is the difference between riding home and pushing.

Good habits

Charge indoors on a hard surface, not on carpet or a bed, and not unattended overnight if you can avoid it. Let the pack cool for twenty minutes after a hard ride before plugging in. Neither is unique to this scooter, both extend the life of any lithium pack.

In stock and shipping from our US warehouse, with US-based support seven days a week.

title: Top Deck for Fighter Supreme 7260R
Magura MT5e Brake Set
body_html:
A complete Magura MT5e hydraulic disc brake set for the front and rear wheel: two levers and two four-piston calipers, with hoses sized for the EMOVE RoadRunner series plus a 3000mm hose for other scooters and bikes.

Built-in brake cutoff

Each lever has an electronic brake sensor that cuts motor power when you pull the lever. The sensor lead ends in a 2-pin male Higo waterproof connector.

Works with: e-bikes whose brake sensor uses a 2-pin connector or a 2-wire lead.

Check before you order: mounting bracket

The calipers need a mounting bracket of the right height for your bike. A bracket is not included in this set, or in any Magura kit, so make sure you have the correct one before ordering.

What's in the box

  • 2 MT5e brake levers with electronic brake sensor
  • 2 MT5e four-piston calipers
  • Front hose, 1000mm (RoadRunner series)
  • Rear hose, 1700mm (RoadRunner series)
  • Additional hose, 3000mm (all other scooters and bikes)
  • 2 M6x12 hex screws
  • 2 olives and 2 inserts
  • Bleeding kit
  • 50ml Magura Royal Blood oil

Not included

  • Caliper mounting bracket
  • Brake rotors, sold separately (see the Magura MDRC 180mm rotor)

Fits: most e-scooters, e-bikes and e-motos, with the correct mounting bracket.

The E Ride Pro 4.0, also sold as the E Ride Pro SS 4.0, is the newest machine in the E Ride Pro line, and every gain went into power. Rated at 7 kW, it spikes to 18 kW peak and pulls 0 to 30 mph in about 2 seconds.

What to know before you buy. The Pro 4.0 is built as an off-road machine and is intended for off-road and private property use. Rider weight limit is 302 lbs. Street legal classification varies by state and city, so check your local regulations before riding on public roads.

Every Pro 4.0 is backed by a 1 year warranty and our US based support team, and ships from our Los Angeles warehouse.

title: Rawrr Mantis Mini R - Best Mini Dirt EBike
body_html:
Rawrr Mantis Mini R — High-Performance Mini Dirt eBike

Unleash trail-ready thrills in a compact package with the Rawrr Mantis Mini R, a mini dirt ebike built for riders who want real power, real handling, and real fun — whether they’re just getting started or stepping up from a smaller ride. Designed with off-road performance, adjustable ride modes, and rugged build quality, the Mini R proves that small size doesn’t mean small capability.

🚀 Power & Performance That Punches Above Its Weight

  • Motor: 2000 W rated / ~4500 W peak — delivers strong torque and excitement off the line.

  • Top Speed: Fast for a mini e-moto and plenty of thrill for trail riding.

  • Acceleration: Quick throttle response and engaging ride dynamics.

🔋 Battery & Range Built for Longer Adventures

  • Battery: 72 V 1440 Wh lithium battery gives a solid balance of punch and range.

  • Range: Up to ~31 miles per charge — great for extended trail sessions.

  • Charge Time: ~3–6 hours depending on charger and outlet.

🧗 Trail-Ready Specs

  • Item Weight: ~111 lbs — lightweight and easy to maneuver.

  • Max Rider Weight: ~255 lbs — makes this mini ebike capable beyond its size.

  • Water Resistance: IP66-rated — ride confidently in wet terrain.

  • Hill Climb: Capable of steep climbs with strong motor torque.

🏁 Rider-Centric Features

  • Display: LCD ride data at a glance.

  • Throttle Type: Twist throttle for smooth control.

  • Brakes: 2-piston hydraulic discs for confident stopping power.

  • Tires:

    • Mini R: 14″ front / 12″ rear — agile and trail-ready.

🛠️ Smart Design & Safety

  • Magnetic Kill Switch: Quick motor cut-off for safety.

  • Brake Sensors & Kickstand Safety: Auto power cut when braking or kickstand engaged.

  • Aluminum Frame & Suspension: Rigid yet lightweight for confident handling.

  • Modular Build: Easier maintenance and upgrade options.

🏍️ Who It’s Built For

The Rawrr Mantis Mini R is a good fit for smaller adults who want real off-road power in a manageable, fun, and confidence-inspiring dirt ebike. Riders under 18 should only ride with adult supervision, a full-face helmet and protective gear, and local age rules apply. Whether you’re carving trails, learning motocross basics, or just craving electric off-road excitement, the Mini R brings serious performance without the weight and intimidation of full-size e-motos.

title: Aptum VM 1 - 48V Mini Pit Dirt EBike
body_html:
⚡ Aptum VM 1 — Compact Dirt eBike, Built to Rip

Meet the Aptum VM 1 Dirt eBike, engineered for riders who want real off-road performance in a lightweight, approachable package. Designed to deliver the thrill with the simplicity of electric power, the VM 1 blends strong torque, smooth acceleration, and durable components for a ride that’s as fun as it is reliable.

Whether you’re hitting trails, exploring backroads, or just looking for an adrenaline-filled ride, the Aptum VM 1 delivers a balanced mix of power, control, and everyday usability.

🛡️ UL 2272 Certified Electrical System

The Aptum VM 1's electrical system is certified to ANSI/CAN/UL 2272, the North American safety standard for electrical systems in personal e-mobility devices. Certification was issued by TÜV Rheinland on 10 June 2026.

UL 2272 is the standard that exists because of e-mobility battery fires. Certification means the battery, charger and electrical system were independently tested against fire and electric shock hazards, including overcharge, short circuit, crush, drop, vibration, thermal cycling and water exposure.

Most mini dirt eBikes in this price range carry no such certification at all. If you are buying for a younger rider, or charging indoors, this is the single most important line on the spec sheet.

Certified scope: electrical system. Tested at 48V / 960Wh.

🔥 Key Features You’ll Love

- Lightweight Off-Road Design: Built with a compact and agile frame, the VM 1 is easy to handle, making it perfect for both newer riders and experienced trail enthusiasts.
- Powerful 2000W Peak Output: Get instant torque and responsive acceleration that lets you climb, carve, and cruise with confidence.
- FarDriver Controller: Power is delivered through an air-cooled FarDriver controller.
- 20 MPH* Top Speed: Fast enough to keep things exciting while staying controlled and manageable across different terrains.
- 31-Mile Riding Range: Equipped with a 48V 20Ah battery, the VM 1 delivers dependable range for trail sessions, cruising, or extended rides.
- DOT Hydraulic Brakes (3/4 System): Reliable stopping power ensures safe and controlled braking, even when riding aggressively or on uneven terrain.
- Smooth & Stable Ride: Designed for off-road comfort, the VM 1 offers a planted feel with stability that inspires confidence on dirt, gravel, and beyond.

⚡ The Aptum VM 1 is the perfect entry into dirt eBiking—lightweight, powerful, and built to keep the ride going.

*Top speed: we publish 20 mph as the figure for public roads and shared paths. The VM 1 is built as an off-road machine and goes faster off-road, which is where it is intended to be ridden. Always follow your local rules.

Key ride features include:

Smart Technology and Rider-Focused Features

Combined with its sleek design and modern electronics, the Space Lite feels like a next-generation urban electric scooter.

Perfect for Daily Commuting

It’s designed for riders who want a scooter that’s powerful enough for city travel yet compact enough to take anywhere.

title: Teverun Blade GT II 60V 30AH with App Control Adult Electric Scooter 2026
body_html:
The Teverun Blade GT II 60V 30Ah App Control Adult Electric Scooter is a 2026 refreshed performance scooter for riders who want high speed, strong range and smart tech in a sleek package. The 2026 model comes with a thumb throttle and the Teverun 2.0 system.

Power and speed

Built around dual high-output motors (about 1,600 W each) with a peak output near 4,900 W, the Blade GT II delivers strong acceleration and torque every time you press the thumb throttle. With a top speed of up to about 53 mph (85 km/h), it sits in the upper tier of adult e-scooter performance.

Thumb throttle and the Teverun 2.0 system

  • Thumb throttle: speed sits under your thumb, so you can hold a steady pace without squeezing a trigger on a long ride.
  • Teverun 2.0 system: use the Teverun app to adjust settings, monitor performance and customize ride modes from your phone.

Battery and range for real riding

  • Battery: 60V 30Ah Samsung (1,800 Wh) with smart BMS.
  • Real-world range: about 50 miles (80 km), enough for longer commutes or weekend rides without constant charging.
  • Charge time: about 15 hours with the stock 67.2V 2A charger.

Handling and ride comfort

  • 11" tubeless tires: puncture-free 90/65-6.5 tires with grip on city cracks and country roads.
  • Spring suspension: front and rear, soaking up bumps and keeping the ride balanced at speed.
  • Full hydraulic brakes: strong, reliable stopping when you need it most.
  • 3" LCD display: clear ride data, plus a remote key and NFC card lock.

Lighting and weather

  • Integrated lighting: headlights, deck lights, brake lights and turn signals for visibility on night rides.
  • IPX6 water resistance: designed to handle wet streets and light rain.

Who the Blade GT II is for

  • Real performance: fast acceleration and a high top speed for spirited riding.
  • Longer range: enough miles to cut down on charging.
  • Smart connectivity: app-driven controls on the Teverun 2.0 system.
  • City or weekend riding: ready for city streets and longer country routes.

title: Teverun Blade Mini Ultra 10 Inch Tires 60V 27AH App Enabled Adult Electric Scooter 2026
body_html:
The Teverun Blade Mini Ultra is a lightweight yet powerful dual-motor electric scooter built for riders who want serious speed, real range, and everyday utility in a portable package. It blends premium components, smart tech, and rugged build quality to deliver one of the most fun and versatile scooters in its class.

Performance that punches above its size

Powered by dual 1000 W motors with around 3200 W peak, the Blade Mini Ultra offers explosive acceleration and confident throttle response. With a top speed of up to about 43 mph, this compact ride performs well beyond typical commuter scooters while staying manageable for daily use.

Range you can plan around

A 60 V 27 Ah pack gives around 50 miles of range. That covers a long commute, a full day of city riding, or a weekend out without hunting for an outlet. Real world range moves with rider weight, terrain, speed and temperature, and riding near the top speed will shorten it noticeably.

Rugged, rider-ready specs

  • Top Speed: about 43 mph (70 km/h)
  • Range: about 50 miles (80 km)
  • Battery: 60 V 27 Ah lithium pack
  • Motors: Dual 1000 W nominal, around 3200 W peak
  • Item Weight: about 72 lbs (33 kg)
  • Max Rider Weight: about 265 lbs (120 kg)
  • Hill Climb Angle: about 30 degrees
  • Tires: 10 in x 3 in tubeless
  • Brakes: Full hydraulic for strong, predictable stopping
  • Water Resistance: IPX6 for rain-ready riding

About the tires

The Blade Mini Ultra runs 10 in x 3 in tubeless tires, so there is no inner tube inside the tire. Run sealant and most small punctures seal themselves as they happen, which means a nail picked up on the way to work is usually something you find later rather than something that stops you at the roadside. There is also no tube to pinch when you drop off a curb hard, and that pinch flat is the puncture most riders actually get.

Carry a plug kit rather than a spare tube, and keep your pressure where it should be. The honest trade with any tubeless setup is that if a tire unseats from the rim, seating it again is a workshop job rather than something you fix on the side of the road.

Smart and rider-friendly features

The Blade Mini Ultra comes with a thumb throttle and an LED display with built-in NFC security, plus headlights, deck lights, brake lights and turn signals for visibility on city streets.

Whether you are commuting, cruising urban routes or carving weekend rides, the Blade Mini Ultra delivers big-scooter performance in a compact, portable form.

title: InMotion RS Jet Electric Scooter: 72V 25Ah Dual 2300W Motors
body_html:
The InMotion RS Jet redefines what a high-performance electric scooter looks like in its class — blending serious power, long range, premium tech, and everyday usability into one sleek ride. If you’re craving speed, torque, and smart features without breaking the bank, the RS Jet delivers exactly that.

⚡ Power That Feels Like a Step Up

Equipped with dual 1,200 W hub motors (4,600 W peak combined), the RS Jet delivers strong acceleration and confident throttle response. It funnily manages to be both beginner-friendly and downright explosive when you twist the throttle, making it perfect for riders upgrading from entry-level scooters or stepping into true performance territory.

🚀 Speed & Range That Keeps You Rolling

  • Top Speed: ~50 mph — fast enough to confidently keep pace with traffic and tackle open roads.

  • Range: Up to ~56 miles per charge — long enough for big city commutes, weekend adventures, or multiple trips without constantly hitting the charger.

  • Battery: 72 V 25 Ah UL2849 certified pack for stability, safety, and solid energy delivery.

  • Charge Time: ~9–10 hours (standard charger) — overnight friendly.

📱 Tech & Control That Feels Premium

One of the RS Jet’s standout features is the 4.3″ full-color touchscreen display — giving you ride stats, customizable settings, performance modes, and real-time feedback right at your fingertips. No fumbling with phone apps — everything you need is right there on the stem.

🏙️ Built for Real-World Riding

This scooter isn’t just about straight-line speed:

  • Hydraulic Disc Brakes (160 mm): Strong, predictable stopping power when you need it.

  • 11″ Tubeless Tires: Excellent traction, puncture resistance, and smoother ride quality.

  • IPX6 Water Resistance: Rain-ready for urban streets and damp conditions.

  • Max Rider Weight: ~330 lbs — accommodating a wide range of riders.

  • Foldable & Portable: Dual stem design that packs down for storage and transport.

🧠 Why Riders Love the RS Jet

The InMotion RS Jet hits a sweet spot between performance and price — giving you motorcycle-level thrills in a ride you can use daily. It’s aggressive enough to satisfy seasoned riders yet accessible enough for those stepping up from commuter scooters.

Whether you’re commuting, cruising city streets, or pushing limits on wide boulevards, the RS Jet delivers value-packed performance with premium tech and real-world range.

title: Hooga Daytona - 72V All Terrain Hyper Scooter
body_html:
Meet the Hooga Daytona, a next-generation hyper electric scooter built for riders who want motorcycle-level performance in a scooter form factor. With a massive 10,000W motor, a 72V LG battery system, and a 72 mph top speed, the Daytona is engineered for speed, stability, and serious riding.

This is not a commuter toy. This is a full-send performance machine.

Extreme Power and Top Speed

The Hooga Daytona delivers up to 10kW of motor output, powered by dual 72V 60A Roadster controllers for instant torque and aggressive acceleration.

Its top speed is 72 mph. Riders have reported seeing 75 to 80 mph in the right conditions, on smooth ground with a lighter rider and a full charge. We publish 72 because that is the figure we stand behind, and we would rather you beat it than be disappointed by it.

Whether you are launching from a stop or pulling hard at speed, throttle response is crisp, controlled, and brutally fun.

Long-Range High-Speed Riding

Equipped with a 72V 40Ah battery using premium LG 21700 cells, the Daytona is built for sustained high-power riding.

  • Up to 40 miles at full speed
  • Up to 80 miles in ideal riding conditions

The battery is UL2849 certified, giving you added peace of mind when it comes to safety and charging reliability.

Charge time is flexible:

  • About 10 hours with one charger
  • About 5 hours with dual chargers

So you can top up overnight or turn it around fast between rides.

Heavy-Duty Build for Big Riders

This scooter is made for real adults. With a max rider weight of 380 lbs and a reinforced chassis weighing 152 lbs, the Daytona stays planted at speed and stable on rough roads. The long wheelbase and wide deck give you room to move and confidence when pushing the limits.

  • Deck width: 12\"
  • Deck length: 23\" (29\" with rear kick plate)

Plenty of stance options whether you are cruising or attacking corners.

Serious Tires, Brakes and Handling

The Daytona rolls on massive 13\" tubeless tires with self-sealing gel, sized 25/60-7 front and rear, giving you excellent grip and added puncture protection at high speeds.

Stopping power comes from 4-piston hydraulic brakes with DOT fluid, delivering strong, predictable braking even during aggressive riding.

And yes, it climbs. With a 45-degree hill climb rating, steep grades will not slow you down.

Full Lighting and Street-Ready Features

The Hooga Daytona does not just go fast. It is fully equipped for real-world riding:

  • Headlights
  • Deck lighting
  • Brake lights
  • Turn signals
  • 3.5\" full-color TFT display
  • Reversed downward finger throttle for better control

Rated IPX6: protected against splashes and light rain. Not for submersion, pressure washing or heavy downpours. Water damage is not covered by the warranty.

Who Is the Hooga Daytona For?

The Hooga Daytona is perfect for riders who want:

  • A 72 mph electric scooter
  • Motorcycle-level acceleration without going full e-moto
  • High rider weight capacity and rock-solid stability
  • Long-range, high-voltage performance
  • Premium components with real safety certifications

If you have outgrown fast scooters and want something that actually scares your friends a little, this is your ride.

Street Legality

Street legality varies by state and city. Check your local laws before you ride on public roads. Rules for electric scooters differ from city to city and state to state, and they change often. Please check with your local authorities before riding on public roads so you know what applies where you live.

title: Teverun Fighter Mini Pro Electric Scooter
body_html:
Teverun Fighter Mini Pro: High-Performance Urban Electric Scooter with Dual Motors

Big power in a compact package. The Teverun Fighter Mini Pro Electric Scooter is built for riders who want speed, range, comfort and smart tech in one commuter machine, for city streets and weekend rides alike.

Power and speed

Powered by dual 1000 W motors (2000 W total nominal) on 28A controllers, with about 3,750 W peak, the Fighter Mini Pro accelerates with confidence and reaches a top speed around 40 mph, fast enough to keep up with urban traffic.

Long-distance range

A high-capacity 60 V 31.8 Ah Samsung battery, new for 2026, delivers up to 62 miles of range on a single charge, so you can commute and explore without frequent stops at the charger.

Rugged build and all-weather riding

An IPX6 water-resistance rating handles wet roads and light rain. 10" tubeless tires and adjustable hydraulic suspension absorb bumps and uneven terrain for a smoother, more controlled ride.

Braking and control

Full hydraulic disc brakes on both wheels, combined with the suspension and a responsive throttle, give confidence in traffic and on open stretches.

Smart tech and rider convenience

The 4" TFT display shows speed, battery life and range, NFC unlock means no key to lose, and Bluetooth and the companion app let you customize settings, enable cruise control and stay synced on the move.

Comfort meets portability

At around 77 lbs and foldable in seconds, the Fighter Mini Pro is easy to carry and store for commuters, apartment dwellers and travelers.

Key features at a glance

  • Top speed: about 40 mph
  • Range: up to about 62 miles per charge
  • Battery: 60 V 31.8 Ah Samsung with smart BMS
  • Motors: dual 1000 W, about 3,750 W peak
  • Controllers: 28A
  • Suspension: adjustable hydraulic
  • Brakes: full hydraulic disc
  • Tires: 10" tubeless
  • Display: 4" TFT with NFC unlock and Bluetooth app control
  • Water resistance: IPX6
  • Portable: foldable design under 80 lbs

Who it is for

Riders who want a fast, fun and reliable electric scooter for daily commuting, errands around town or exploring the city.

title: Teverun Fighter Supreme 7260R V6 Electric Scooter
body_html:
The Teverun Fighter Supreme 7260R V6 is a top-tier high-performance electric scooter for riders who want maximum speed, long range and premium components in one ready-to-ride machine.

Power and speed

Dual 2500 W motors on dual 100A controllers put out up to about 16,800 W peak combined, for explosive acceleration. Riders can push it to about 75 mph (120 km/h) on open terrain, making it one of the fastest production scooters on the market.

Long-distance capability

A 72 V 60 Ah high-capacity battery (about 4,320 Wh) with smart BMS:

  • Range: up to about 124 miles (200 km) on a single charge, for long commutes or multi-day rides.
  • Recharge time: about 12 hours from empty with the included charger, or about 3 hours with the optional fast charger.

Handling and ride quality

  • Adjustable hydraulic suspension absorbs rough terrain and keeps the ride controlled.
  • Dual steering dampers add stability at high speed and reduce wobble.
  • 13" x 5" tubeless tires for traction, puncture resistance and a smooth ride on imperfect roads.
  • 4-piston hydraulic brakes for strong, reliable stopping.

Smart features

  • Large color TFT display for ride data at a glance.
  • Full LED lighting and integrated turn signals for visibility.
  • App integration (iOS/Android) for settings, ride modes and diagnostics.
  • NFC key and GPS tracking options for security.
  • Foldable design for storage and transport.

Who it is for

  • Top-tier speed and acceleration
  • Real long-range capability for long commutes or tours
  • Premium suspension and braking for confidence at speed
  • Smart tech and safety features for everyday use

title: E Ride Pro SR - Powerful Dirt EBike
body_html:
Meet the E Ride Pro SR: Power, Comfort, and Control in One Stunning Dirt EBike

If you're looking for an dirt ebike that combines incredible power, premium comfort, and unbeatable control, the E Ride Pro SR is your dream ride.

With a top speed of 20mph out of the box,

It's built to dominate trails, offer smooth handling, and turn heads wherever you go.

But before you jump in, you probably have some questions: Is this ebike worth the investment? Can it handle rugged trails? Will it offer the comfort I need for long rides?

Let’s dive into why the E Ride Pro SR might just be the answer you’re looking for.

 

Unleashing True Power: Why It Matters

Let’s start with what sets the E Ride Pro SR apart from other dirt ebikes, ridiculous power. This isn’t just an ebike to get you from point A to point B; it’s a high-performance machine designed for serious riders who want more.

With this level of power, you’ll experience instant acceleration and the ability to conquer steep hills, rough terrain, or anything else that comes your way.

Whether you're ripping through trails or just cruising on open roads, the E Ride Pro SR ensures that you always have more than enough power on tap.

More power means faster acceleration, easier hill climbs, and a thrilling ride every time.

The fine-tuned motor ensures that the E Ride Pro SR can handle the toughest terrains without breaking a sweat.

 

Upgraded Brakes for Next-Level Control

Now, what’s the use of power if you can’t control it? One of the biggest concerns riders have with high-powered ebikes is braking. Will it stop when you need it to? The E Ride Pro SR comes with upgraded brakes for strong, controllable stopping.

Whether you're zipping down a steep hill or maneuvering through a tricky path, these brakes are built for strong, predictable stopping. Stopping distance still depends on your speed, the surface and the condition of the brakes.

  • Real-world advantage: on a steep downhill trail, strong brakes help you control your speed. Ride within your limits and check the brakes before every ride.

Comfort Built Right In: A Seat Designed for You

Let's be honest. Comfort often gets overlooked in the world of dirt ebikes.

Riders usually think they have to sacrifice comfort for performance, but with the E Ride Pro SR, that’s not the case.

The ebike comes with a newly designed seat that provides maximum comfort for those long rides. Whether you're out for a day of trail riding or commuting through the city, this seat is built to keep you comfortable for the long haul.

Riding shouldn’t be a pain, literally.

With the E Ride Pro SR, the seat design ensures you won’t be sore after an intense day of riding, meaning more time on the trail and less recovery time.

 

Who is the E Ride Pro SR For?

If you're someone who craves adventure and isn’t satisfied with the average dirt ebike, then the E Ride Pro SR is for you.

This isn’t just a machine for weekend warriors. It's for riders who want to push limits, explore challenging terrains, and enjoy every ride to the fullest.

  • Power seekers: If you love the adrenaline rush that comes with speed and power, the E Ride Pro SR’s power is exactly what you’re after.
  • Trail enthusiasts: If you’re always on the hunt for new trails to conquer, this ebike’s performance and upgraded braking system will give you confidence on the trail.
  • Comfort-driven riders: Tired of ebikes that leave you aching after every ride? The E Ride Pro SR’s new seat design ensures you’ll be as comfortable on your ride back home as you were when you started.

If you ever thought about getting an dirt ebike, maybe something like the Altis Sigma or E Ride Pro SS, but never had the courage to get one, the E Ride Pro SR might just be the perfect one for you.

title: 11" Self Sealing Street/Off-Road Tubeless Tires
body_html:
The 11" Self Sealing Street/Off-Road Tubeless Tires are an awesome upgrade for models with 6.5in. rims (or 11in. motors). As tubeless (pneumatic) tires, they are highly durable, provide ample road cushion, and do not have inner tubes that you have to replace. With a wider than usual profile, you will feel ultra stable and connected to the road. These tires are called self sealing because the interior is coated in a bonded sealant. If punctures occur, the coating seals the damage from the inside, retaining the tires inflation and structure. Also called no-flat tires, they can get punctured but quickly seal to retain air. They are far less prone to flats than pneumatic tires with inner tubes, as a common cause of flats is the inner tube getting stuck in the rim. These 11" Self Sealing Street/Off-Road Tubeless Tires come in street and off-road styles, and fit many of our popular Kaabo electric scooters and Dualtron electric scooters (compatible models below). These are the standard 11in. tires for the following models: Dualtron Thunder 2, King GT, and Warrior GT
